proposals.announcement_evidence: F-15 original equipment manufacturer infrastructure support
proposals.rationale: Rejected under §3's generic-services pattern. The contract provides continued program support, post-production engineering and logistics services for the Air Force, Air National Guard, Israeli Air Force and Royal Saudi Air Force, funded with centralized asset management and foreign military sales money. OEM infrastructure support is exactly 'engineering support, logistics' held against a platform the contract supports; aircraft procurement BLI F01500 buys F-15 aircraft and modifications, and neither CAM nor FMS money executes that line.
